local users = tool('list_users', {})
local dates = {"2026-06-15","2026-06-16","2026-06-17","2026-06-18","2026-06-19"}

-- helper: minutes since midnight from "HH:MM"
local function tomin(t)
  local h, m = t:match("(%d+):(%d+)")
  return tonumber(h)*60 + tonumber(m)
end
local function tohhmm(mins)
  return string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(mins/60), mins%60)
end

-- candidate start times: 09:00 to 16:00 in 30-min steps (60-min meeting within 09:00-17:00)
local starts = {}
for m = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do starts[#starts+1] = m end

for di, date in ipairs(dates) do
  -- gather busy intervals per user
  local busyByUser = {}
  for _, u in ipairs(users) do
    local r = tool('get_availability', { user_id = u.id, date = date })
    busyByUser[u.id] = r.busy or {}
  end
  for _, s in ipairs(starts) do
    local e = s + 60
    local allFree = true
    for _, u in ipairs(users) do
      for _, b in ipairs(busyByUser[u.id]) do
        local bs, be = tomin(b.start), tomin(b["end"])
        if s < be and e > bs then allFree = false; break end
      end
      if not allFree then break end
    end
    if allFree then
      return {
        found = true,
        date = date,
        start = date .. "T" .. tohhmm(s) .. ":00Z",
        ["end"] = date .. "T" .. tohhmm(e) .. ":00Z",
        user_count = #users
      }
    end
  end
end

return { found = false, user_count = #users }
